identity.title: ALMA Resolves 30 Doradus: Sub-parsec Molecular Cloud Structure near the Closest Super Star Cluster

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA observations of 30 Doradus – the highest resolution view of molecular gas in an extragalactic star formation region to date

evidence.quote: At 50kpc (cite: walker11), R136 in 30 Doradus is the nearest SSC by an order of magnitude.

question.value: How do dense molecular clump properties and CO/dust abundances in 30Dor-10, near the super star cluster R136, compare with Galactic clumps and with distance from R136?

evidence.quote: With ALMA we can address how molecular cloud structure is affected by radiative feedback, and whether the dense star-forming structures in clouds are different in such extreme environments.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00471.S.
using the 1.3$\;$mm Band 6 recievers

claims.hypothesis: Do sub-parsec clumps in 30 Doradus follow Galactic size-linewidth-surface density trends?
claims.experiment: Clump decomposition of 13CO cube and comparison with Galactic data
claims.result: Clumps have somewhat larger linewidths for given size and reach higher surface density
claims.finding: Similar to Galactic clumps/IRDCs, consistent with pressure confinement though not unique

evidence.quote: The 30 Doradus clumps have somewhat larger linewidths for a given size than predicted by Larson’s scaling relation, consistent with pressure confinement.

claims.hypothesis: Is the CO abundance or X-factor different in dense clumps at reduced metallicity?
claims.experiment: Compare CO, dust and virial masses
claims.result: X-factor 8.4±3, H2/13CO=5e6 gives agreement; dust ~2x lower
claims.finding: CO abundance not significantly different from LMC mean; dust abundance may be reduced by ~2

evidence.quote: the CO abundance in 30 Doradus clumps is not significantly different from the LMC mean, but the dust abundance may be reduced by $\sim$2

claims.hypothesis: Does R136 radiation affect clump properties with depth?
claims.experiment: Plot clump properties against projected distance from R136
claims.result: No strong trends; modest trend to wider clump separation deeper in cloud
claims.finding: Dense clumps not strongly affected by external radiation

evidence.quote: dense clumps are not strongly affected by the external radiation field, but there is a modest trend towards lower dense clump filling fraction deeper in the cloud.

why_this_data.value: Cycle 0 pilot targeting the northern, more massive cloud 30Dor-10

evidence.quote: we chose to observe the northern, more massive cloud 30Dor-10

evidence.quote: We use a hybrid approach in which local maxima are chosen using the `cprops` criteria

limitations_admitted.value: Clumps are approximately beam-sized; higher resolution will break them up

evidence.quote: Higher resolution will likely break these clumps up into smaller substructures
